text:
maya: Heads-up — we have to lock the SCL (Santiago) edge marketplace onboarding next week. Need quota sign-off, KMS key handoff, and a joint announcement window.

jason: Timeline? I thought EdgeComputeCo wanted to go live 3/29.

emily: that's still the ask from product side. Can we get quotas approved by 3/26?

maya: target 3/26 for quota + 3/28 for KMS verification. Carlos — can EdgeComputeCo confirm KMS HSM availability for SCL zone?

carlos (EdgeComputeCo): yes, we can provision BYOK HSM in southamerica-west2. Will need an API key exchange and a test ciphertext roundtrip. ETA 48h after we get the service account.

emily: perfect. ops-bot, do we have capacity quota request in flight with the cloud partner for southamerica-west2?

ops-bot: Quota request #Q-94231 submitted to CloudPartner on 1765432120. Current status: awaiting partner review. Estimated review SLA: 72h.

jason: note — marketplace listing requires the region SKU entitlement proof. Carlos can you share the SKU list your infra team will expose? quick CSV is fine.

carlos (EdgeComputeCo): sharing tiny CSV now: `edge_scl_skus.csv` (uploaded). Follow-up: two SKUs need a special driver (nvdriver-v2). We need a node image that includes it.

emily: ops will coordinate the image build. maya can you add image requirements to the runbook?

maya: will do. Runbook checklist: 1) Quota approval & entitlement doc 2) KMS BYOK exchange (RSA/EC cert) 3) Node image with nvdriver-v2 4) Marketplace listing assets (logos, SLA blob) 5) Joint PR date 3/30 window 6) Rollback plan + canary policy

jason: PR date okay for marketing? They want a 1-week lead but can squeeze into 3/30 if we finalize assets by 3/27.

emily: put assets deadline 3/27 EOD. I'll ping growth.

carlos (EdgeComputeCo): on our side: we need the service account email to bind KMS policy and the marketplace entitlement test account. Send to carlos@edgecompute.co.

maya: sending now. Also adding policy snippet to runbook so legal signs off on data flow.

ops-bot: Reminder: if quota review extends beyond SLA, we need escalation to partner-ops alias. Use `#partner-ops-escalate` channel.

jason: small technical Q — can we support automatic key rotation in the BYOK flow? EdgeComputeCo?

carlos (EdgeComputeCo): yes, rotation supported. We should schedule a post-launch rotation at +30 days. We will provide rotation tooling.

emily: final checklist item — can we do a dry-run for end-to-end provisioning (quota -> image -> KMS -> entitlement) on 3/26 afternoon? Prefer 1400 CLT.

maya: 3/26 14:00 CLT works for me. Carlos + ops team confirm?

carlos (EdgeComputeCo): confirmed. We'll join with infra lead and provide test keys.

jason: I'll create the test harness script and drop it in the runbook: `scripts/scl_e2e_test.sh` — includes quota check, node boot, and KMS encrypt/decrypt.

emily: thanks — once dry-run passes we can flip to canary and schedule marketplace publish.

maya: awesome. I'll update the runbook and create a shared calendar invite for 3/26 14:00 CLT + include marketing/legal.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: SCL Marketplace dry-run — 1765432160. Participants: maya, jason, emily, carlos (EdgeComputeCo).

jason: one last note — include rollback tag so infra can drain traffic if node image fails: `rollback:scl-image-v1`

maya: noted. Thanks all — will post updated runbook shortly. :rocket:
